title: ork status lists stopped runs that the needs-you count leaves out
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: ork status --project ork says 'needs you 3' but lists three stopped S21 runs, two of which no longer count under #92 ui.stopped-newer, and the TUI shows only the newest. The list and the count disagree, so it is unclear what the owner must act on.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Seen 2026-10-20: ork status --project ork says 'needs you 3' but lists three stopped S21 runs, two of which no longer count under #92 ui.stopped-newer, and the TUI shows only the newest. The list and the count disagree, so it is unclear what the owner must act on.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Stopped runs hidden by #92 are not listed as needing you (or are marked as superseded).
- The listed rows match the counted rows.
- A stopped run with no newer run is still listed.
